To connect your private GitHub repository, please **tap the GitHub icon at the top of the chat**.

Because **soulahmd/jarvis-ai-assistant** is private, GitHub authentication is handled securely through the app interface rather than direct terminal cloning. Once you tap the GitHub icon to authorize and connect your repository:

- Your repository and history will sync directly into this workspace.
- Your project files, code, and folder structure will be preserved.
- No new template or blank project will be initialized.

After connecting via the GitHub button, let me know and I will list your project files to verify that everything is loaded properly!
